meaning:
Timnath-heres (or Timnath-serah) = "portion of the sun" or "abundant portion"
a city given to Joshua as a inheritance in the mountains of Ephraim on the north of the hill of Gaash where he was buried
Also named: tim.nat se.rach (תִּמְנַת סֶ֫רַח "Timnath-serah" H8556B)

elsewhere.note: According to Yahweh’s commandment, they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and lived…
They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath Heres, in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.
